notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
You have at least two cards in hand.
description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Zombie and Soldier enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve the first Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, causing you to put a phyresis counter on it and draw a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Blasting Station trigger, sacrificing the Soldier token instead.
Repeat.
